name: HardCodedTestDouble
summary: Has its return values and expected calls written into it, so that a double needed in one shape only costs nothing to configure.

roles.name: HardCodedTestDouble
roles.summary: A double built by hand for one job, with no way to tell it anything. The right choice while there is one job; the wrong one by the fifth near-copy, which is the point at which the book sends a reader to the configurable kind.
